# Bedir AI

> Source-cited question answering over Qur'an and hadith texts, plus an HTTP API.
> Built on Anthropic's Claude Messages API: the corpus is passed as document blocks with
> server-side citations enabled, so every answer carries the verbatim passage it came from.

Operator: Mevlana Yalçın (founder), Ankara, Türkiye · merhaba@bedirsavasi.com
Started: March 2026 (domain registered 2026-03-08, Verisign RDAP) · funding: bootstrapped, no outside round
Status: early access, one person, no customers claimed

## Product

- [Turkish](https://bedirsavasi.com/) · [English](https://bedirsavasi.com/en/) · [German](https://bedirsavasi.com/de/) · [Arabic](https://bedirsavasi.com/ar/)
- [Company record](https://bedirsavasi.com/en/company/) — operator, started date, verification links
- [API documentation](https://bedirsavasi.com/en/api/) — endpoint, response shape, errors, rate limit

## API

    POST https://bedirsavasi.com/api/ask
    {"q": "Which verse describes the help given at Badr?", "lang": "en"}

Response: `answer[].text` with `[n]` markers, `answer[].cites[]` carrying `id`, `title`,
`url` and the verbatim `quote`; `provider` names the engine that answered; `usage` and
`retrieval` are returned. Rate limit: 8 requests per 60 seconds per IP. No auth, no SLA.
Answers are produced by `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`; if the daily budget is exhausted the
endpoint falls back to a labelled non-Claude engine and says so in `provider`.

## Source data

- [Published corpus](https://bedirsavasi.com/data/corpus.json) — 111 documents, version 2026-10-07
- Scope: the Battle of Badr. Qur'an: Āl ʿImrān 3:12, 3:121-127 and Al-Anfāl 8:1-76 (41 passages);
  hadith: 68 Sahih al-Bukhari + 2 Sahih Muslim, numbered as on sunnah.com.
- Language coverage, measured: Arabic 111/111, English 111/111, Turkish 110/111, German 41/111.
- Sources: Tanzil (Uthmani) and api.alquran.cloud renderings (Diyanet Vakfı, Saheeh International,
  Bubenheim & Elyas); hadith via fawazahmed0/hadith-api. Licensing notes: `DATA_NOTES.md`.

## Code

- [github.com/mevlanayalcin/bedir-ai](https://github.com/mevlanayalcin/bedir-ai) — Worker source, corpus,
  build scripts, and a citation-fidelity evaluation harness (written, not yet run at scale).

## Claims we do not make

No user count, no revenue, no funding round, no institution pilot, and no accuracy benchmark
has been run yet. The corpus is scoped to one event; questions outside it should be refused,
and the refusal behaviour is what the evaluation measures.
